state.seed_assertion: Innovative use or application of new technological or organisational solutions where personal and societal consequences are not necessarily well researched and known is a criterion triggering DPIA requirements.

sentences.1: Innovative use or application of new technological or organisational solutions where personal and societal consequences are not necessarily well researched and known is a criterion triggering DPIA requirements.
sentences.2: Innovative use or applying new technological or organisational solutions - Explanation and examples: Innovative use or combining existing and new technologies, where personal and societal consequences are not necessarily well researched and known
sentences.3: Innovative use or application of new technological or organizational solutions, which can involve novel forms of data collection and usage, possibly with a high risk to individuals' rights and freedoms is a type of processing subject to DPIA requirement.
sentences.4: Innovative use or application of new technological or organizational solutions, which can involve novel forms of data collection and usage, possibly with a high risk to individuals ' rights and freedoms, like the combined use of fingerprint and face recognition for improved physical access control, or mhealth applications, or other "smart" applications from which user profiles are generated (e.g.
sentences.5: daily habits), or artificial intelligence applications as well as publicly accessible blockchains that include personal data.
sentences.6: Processing involving the use of innovative technologies, or the novel application of existing technologies including AI, requires a DPIA where this processing is combined with any of the criteria from the European guidelines.
sentences.7: Innovative technology: processing involving the use of innovative technologies, or the novel application of existing technologies (including AI).
sentences.8: Examples of processing using innovative technology include artificial intelligence, machine learning and deep learning;
sentences.9: A DPIA must be done when personal data is collected from a source other than the individual without providing them with a privacy notice because of application of article 14(5)(b) GDPR in conjunction with the criterion that personal data is processed in innovative use or applying new technological or organisational solutions.
sentences.10: Processing involving the use of innovative technologies, or the novel application of existing technologies including AI, requires a DPIA when combined with any of the criteria from the European guidelines according to the ICO list.
sentences.11: Innovative technology: processing involving the use of innovative technologies, or the novel application of existing technologies (including AI).
sentences.12: A DPIA must be done when personal data is collected from a source other than the individual without providing them with a privacy notice because of application of article 14(5)(b) GDPR in conjunction with the criterion that processed personal data is concerning vulnerable data subjects.
